title: AI command injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot discloses information (CVE-2025-32711)
summary: Microsoft published CVE-2025-32711, an information disclosure vulnerability in Microsoft 365 Copilot in which AI command injection lets an unauthorized attacker disclose information over a network.
impact: Disclosure of data reachable by the user's Copilot to an unauthorized attacker
source: Vendor security advisory and CVE record
